references.text: God warned Israel that enemies would devour their crops if they were disobedient to the covenant
Moses' curse predicted that enemies would take Israel's livestock and destroy their crops as punishment for disobedience
The context explaining that the Midianites came against Israel every time they sowed
The continuation describing how the enemies came with their herds and destroyed the land like locusts
Gideon threshed wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites, showing how serious the situation was
The prophecy that a nation would devour the crops, grain, and wine, the oxen and sheep
Describes the destruction of crops left by locusts, similar to the destruction caused by the Midianites
